text:
Absolutely — keeping it short and newborn-friendly.

1. **Chili-crisp chicken stir-fry**: ground chicken, green beans, garlic, soy, chili crisp; serve over rice. Fast, one pan, easy to eat one-handed.
2. **Sheet-pan sausage with peppers and onions**: toss on one tray, roast, done. Minimal cleanup.
3. **Coconut chickpea curry**: chickpeas, frozen spinach, curry paste, coconut milk; finish with chili crisp. Cheap, forgiving, and reheats well.
4. **Skillet taco rice**: beef, turkey, or beans + salsa + rice + cheese. Good for leftovers.
5. **Salmon and broccoli tray bake**: lemon, olive oil, broccoli, salmon; serve with couscous or rice. Very low effort.

If you want, I can turn this into a 5-night plan + grocery list.

attributes.reason: Gives five meal ideas with details, so it’s much longer than very brief.
Focuses on quick one-pan, sheet-pan, skillet, and low-cleanup dinners.
Includes chicken, sausage, beef, turkey, and salmon rather than vegetarian options.
Uses chili crisp and curry paste, leaning into a spicy style.
